items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: We could all, like I know David Jones, myself, and Thudder Poirnell, but we didn't do all that was head stuff.

ctx.x: Did you read music at that place?
Well, we didn't do too much reading there, no. We could all, like I know David Jones, myself, and Thudder Poirnell, but we didn't do all that was head stuff.
Did you play things like blues there?
